agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Lildozer fainted only after entering for Ponyta and executing Bulldoze twice plus Ice Shard; the later Croakatoa entry finished the 2-HP target safely. No no-action pivot occurred.

Bushtank fainted to poison after three Razor Leafs into Eelektrik. It completed its assigned damage role before the forced replacement; no verified alternative lexicographically dominates preserving Croakatoa for later.
Bugatti attacked Sunflora twice and then fainted to a critical Sludge Bomb. The critical hit caused the loss of Bugatti; it was not switch churn or a deterministic policy error.
Birdlaw attacked Dustox twice before fainting to Venoshock; forced Ohmnomnom then finished. This was productive damage, not a switch-in-and-out cycle.

All eight switches were matchup entries or forced replacements. Every voluntary entrant acted before leaving; there were zero immediate reversals, consecutive no-action switches, or status-prevented moves.
The battle required 28 decisions. No shorter line was verified to improve survival, win reliability, or strategic preservation.

correct_choices: Every voluntary switch-in produced at least one move before leaving; the observed switch spam defect did not recur.
Fake Out was used only on fresh entry and each use produced a free hit.
No move was selected while deterministically asleep or frozen.
The authoritative terminal state verified victory with Ohmnomnom at 5 HP and Croakatoa at 42 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged-bundle Clone 2 from the identical opening; repeat the no-action-switch, immediate-reversal, fresh-only Fake Out, and deterministic-status audits.
